message: "Hello."

name: Rina
message: "Oh, hello~. I see you're alone today~"

name: Rina
message: "Micchan, your friend's come to see you~"
"Hello, Micchan."

name: Rina
message: "Thank you, as always. Look how happy Micchan is."

name: Rina
message: "Micchan seems to really like you. She's always looking forward to seeing you again."

name: Rina
message: "Isn't that nice, Micchan? You got to see your friend again~"
(Thank her)

name: Rina
message: "Huh...? Oh, you mean about Senpai?"

name: Rina
message: "You don't need to thank me. I didn't really do much. So, did you get to meet Senpai's family? That's great."

name: Rina
message: "I might not be able to do much, but if something else comes up—"

name: Rina
message: "Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't notice you had company."
At some point, the little thought-form had come over and was standing right beside me.
She's... staring at Uribayashi-san?

name: Rina
message: "Hm? Is something wrong?"

name: Rina
message: "Oh my... So you're looking for your mom..."

name: Rina
message: "You're lost? Oh, you poor thing..."
Is she... talking to her?

name: Rina
message: "You must've been so scared. But it's okay now. I'll help you look for her."

name: Rina
message: "Why not stay with us until you find her? Come, don't be shy."

name: Rina
message: "Okay then. I'll take care of her. Don't worry, I'll look after her properly until we find her mother."

name: Rina
message: "We should get going now. Come see us again soon, okay? Micchan would be so happy."

name: Rina
message: "Now, Micchan, say goodbye to your friend~. Buh-bye~"
"Bye-bye."

name: Rina
message: "Don't worry, you're not alone anymore. I'll always be by your side."

name: Rina
message: "Good news for you too, Micchan~. You've made a new friend~. Yay~"
They left.
Was that really for the best?
It probably was. I think.
I hope it'll help heal Uribayashi-san and those children's souls.
Time to go.
I should offer a prayer.
(Pray)
(Put in an offering)
"Thank you for everything."
Time to go.
Gyaruko-san isn't here.
I should print the photo.
And paste it into the Death Diary.
...I should head back.

name: Lumina
message: "What, you ignoring me now?"

name: Lumina
message: "Ah, guess she just can't see me anymore. Well, that's no fun."

name: Lumina
message: "Really, though. What's she so happy about anyway?"

name: Lumina
message: "It's all pointless."

name: Lumina
message: "...Ah. Since she can't see me, I could do anything I want right now and she wouldn't know what hit her."

name: Lumina
message: "Hmmm.... right... interesting..."

name: Lumina
message: "Yeah, this is pissing me off. I'm not letting you get your happy ending."

name: Lumina
message: "Guess I'll curse her, nice and slow."

name: Lumina
message: "Anyone who's happier than me deserves to be miserable."

name: Lumina
message: "Alright, it's settled. This is gonna be fun."

name: Nagisa
message: "...Found you~"

name: Lumina
message: "Wha?"
(Open the Death Diary)

The moment that man stabbed me in the stomach, everything came rushing back.\k
I hesitated for a long time, but I'm sure you'd want to know.
So I'll write down everything I remember about that moment.

%n;It was a Saturday, and our parents had an appointment they absolutely couldn't cancel.\k
My classes ended at noon, so I was supposed to come home before they left and look after you.

But my teacher's lecture ran long, so I got home a little later than planned.\k
Mom and Dad figured leaving you alone for ten minutes at most would be fine, so they went ahead and left.\k
When I rushed home, the front door was unlocked, and you were nowhere to be found.

%n;I think... you must have heard from Mom and Dad that I'd be coming home soon, and went out to meet me.\k
You never really liked playing outside, and you were always so well-behaved.
There's no way you would have gone out on your own for no reason.

So I'm sure you didn't do it for yourself.
You must've thought I'd feel lonely if I came home to an empty house, so you tried your best, unlocked the door, and worked up the courage to go outside.

%n;I found you at our usual park.\k
You were crying your eyes out. A man I didn't know was trying to snatch you away.\k
I panicked, and everything from there was a blur.

I screamed and ran as fast as I could, trying to get you back from him.\k
"Someone, help!" "I'm calling the police!"
I probably yelled a bunch of other things too.\k
Then I finally got you back. But I felt something strange in my stomach.

It's still so vivid in my head, the alien sensation of something foreign pushing into me, again and again.\k
It was a knife. I'd been stabbed with a knife.
As soon as I realized that, I felt horribly sick, and my body went limp.
%n;My memories cut off there.
Just like Gyaruko-san said, I didn't know what happened after that.

%n;Did I save you?\k
Were you safe?\k
That was the regret keeping me here.

But it turns out, I really did save you.\k
I even got to see you again, all grown up.\k
I'm so glad...

%n;Now, there's just one thing that's still worrying me.\k
You might be blaming yourself for what happened.\k
If you are, then you really shouldn't carry that weight.

It was simply bad luck.\k
And I'm proud I could keep you safe.

%n;You did nothing wrong, Shiika.\k
So I'd really be happy if you remembered me as a brave big sister rather than an object of guilt and regret.

I've always loved your smile.\k
So please, keep smiling from now on, always.\k
That's my wish as your big sister.

%n;P.S.
Make sure you read the next page too!
Dear Shiika,
%n;Your big sister lived a happy life. I was so, so happy.
%n;I hope your life from here on will be overflowing with happiness too.
%n;——From your big sister, who loves you more than anyone in the world.
(Close the Death Diary)
